name: Yoru Aoi
source:
Yoru Aoi might seem tough, but he's actually really shy. He's only willing to open himself up more if he's around the right people, like Akihiko.

Even though he's shy, Aoi doesn't hold on saying what he really feels, always preferring sincerity.

...He's also Akihiko's crush!

[From [url=https://stefannofornari-games.itch.io/dont-give-up-on-me]itch.io[/url]]
